_comment: Canonical plotting style for embedding models and their families, shared across paper figures that contrast decoding targets (e.g. language_vs_visual). Single source of truth (see README.md) — never hard-code these in a figure script. `families`: language vs vision, each with a band/trace `color` and legend `label`. `models`: per-model line `color` (used in legends and the layer sweep) and its `family`; `group_color` is an OPTIONAL second colour used only where bars are grouped BY language model and the family blue would be ambiguous (panel d of language_vs_visual) — language models use purple/green there because blue already denotes the language family in the time-course/preference panels.
